title: PsiTweaker
description: A Psi addon that makes some things configurable
body:
A [Psi](https://modrinth.com/mod/psi) addon that makes some things configurable



Makes psi capacity, regeneration rate, regeneration cooldown after casting and taking damage, psi lost from damage, overflow damage and spell bullet cost multipliers configurable with expressions. See [the readme](https://github.com/gdavid04/PsiTweaker/blob/master/README.md) for more information on configuration options.

Without configuration changes, this mod does not alter anything by default.

This mod should be installed on both client and server with matching configurations.
